Common Questions

What should stay on a small kitchen counter and what should be stored away?

Keep only items you touch every single day (coffee maker, dish soap caddy, salt/oil) and move occasional appliances and utensil crocks into cabinets or vertical racks.

Do magnetic fridge racks scratch stainless steel refrigerators?

Look for racks with soft silicone-backed magnets and place them carefully without dragging to keep your fridge side scratch-free.
